concept: NACL: stateless — outbound rule for ephemeral ports
tests: Understanding the stateless nature of NACLs: return traffic needs an explicit outbound rule for ephemeral ports.
expected: The custom NACL has no outbound allow for ephemeral ports 1024–65535 — responses to 443 are dropped. Triggers: "SG allows 443", "custom Network ACL", "unreachable from the internet".
why_not: Security Groups are stateful and allow return traffic automatically; an IGW has no stateful/stateless behavior; a route table does not route "to a security group".
